channel.title: Pier & Point · MB360 (701 China Basin St)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for MB360 (701 China Basin St) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · MB360 (701 China Basin St): The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8710009 lists the address 701 China Basin St. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8710009.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): Two records carry the MB360 name, one for each block's…
item.description: Two records carry the MB360 name, one for each block's address, so each name now includes its street address to tell them apart. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: Not a sourced name change: both records already used MB360 (701 China Basin St and 1200 4th St) in their research notes..
item.source: Not a sourced name change: both records already used MB360 (701 China Basin St and 1200 4th St) in their research notes.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): The 2013 start is shown as a year: The Registry reported…
item.description: The 2013 start is shown as a year: The Registry reported on May 1, 2013 that BRE "has begun vertical construction", without giving a start date. The 188-unit figure comes from the Assessor roll; the architect's project page gives 170 units for Block 5 and 190 for Block 11 and does not say which block is 701 China Basin St. The $227 million figure is an expected development cost for the whole development. Source: https://news.theregistrysf.com/bre-starts-construction-on-mission-bay-project/ ; https://ignitionarch.com/project/mb360/ ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8710&lot=009.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): Notes on pages that could not be read are now plain…
item.description: Notes on pages that could not be read are now plain statements, and mapping-process detail is left to the shape's own notes. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): MB360's 188 units now cite the Assessor roll alone
item.description: MB360's 188 units now cite the Assessor roll alone; the architect's page cited gives no unit count for this block. The 2014 fire is described as CBS News did: the unfinished building was destroyed and demolished. Source: DataSF Assessor Secured Roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8710009; Ignition Architecture, MB 360º project page; CBS News San Francisco, 2014-05-07.

item.description: MB360 now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8710009.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): The MB360 page now gives Ignition Architecture's figure…
item.description: The MB360 page now gives Ignition Architecture's figure of 362 units for the two blocks (170 and 190) and says no source gives 360 units, which looks like the project's name. The Assessor gives 188 units for this parcel; the figures are not reconciled. Source: Ignition Architecture, MB 360 (ignitionarch.com/project/mb360/).

item.description: Added a photo taken on site on September 30, 2026. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): The map notes said the unit count was unresolved between…
item.description: The map notes said the unit count was unresolved between 188 and 360 and that the building dated from 2014. Ignition Architecture gives 362 units for the two blocks together and 2016 for completion, and the Assessor gives 188 units and 2016 for this parcel, so the notes now say that. The summary no longer states a 2014 Essex acquisition year (no cited source gives one), the CBS News source title now matches the displayed headline, the 2013 milestone also cites Ignition for Blocks 5 and 11, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: Ignition Architecture, MB 360 (https://ignitionarch.com/project/mb360/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 701 China Basin St (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8710&lot=009); CBS News San Francisco, 2014-05-07 (https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/news/investigators-report-san-francisco-mission-bay-fire-at-mb360-development-was-accidental-likely-caused-by-welding/); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Complete · MB360 (701 China Basin St): This block (701 China Basin St) is completed: the… (~2016)
item.description: This block (701 China Basin St) is completed: the Assessor roll (DataSF, parcel 8710009) gives year built 2016 and 188 units, and the architect's project page (Ignition Architecture, undated) gives "Completion 2016" for the development and "Units 362 total; Block 5 = 170 ... Block 11 = 190" rather than 188, without naming the street address of either block; the 188 rests on the Assessor alone. Both are year-only, not reports written after the completion (~2016). Source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project).
item.source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project)

item.title: Under construction · MB360 (701 China Basin St): BRE Properties' ~360-unit MB360… (~2013)
item.description: BRE Properties' ~360-unit MB360 development (Blocks 5 and 11 of Mission Bay, per the architect's project page) is reported to have begun vertical construction. The Registry, published May 1, 2013, says BRE "has begun vertical construction on its 360-unit MB360 apartment development"; that is an announcement, so the start date itself is not known and only the year is shown (SFGate, March 2014: "Construction began last year" on the building that burned) (~2013). Source: The Registry (Northern California real estate news), 2013-05-01; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project).
item.source: The Registry (Northern California real estate news), 2013-05-01; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project)
